text: The FastAPI service works, but only on Jordan's own laptop. Caleb Shaw takes it from one machine to Wrenfield's actual Azure environment.
A real Dockerfile packages the service and its exact dependencies, built through Azure Container Registry so the image lands right where Container Apps will pull it from.
It deploys behind internal-only ingress -- this is an employee tool, not a public one -- with secrets wired in as Container Apps secret references, never baked into the image.
Priya Desai's HR team and a few of Omar Haddad's IT desk staff try it for real. Fast, accurate answers, a clean rollout, no restarts, no throttling.
Next: Lena Ortiz's pre-launch red-team security review finds something nobody was looking for.
